parameters.content:
## Controlled offline proof
20 fictional deals, no credentials and no external calls. A manual run creates reproducible test cases.

## Controlled handoff
Required fields → approval → duplicate check → project → folder → CRM. Partial failures trigger compensation in reverse order.

## Acceptance
Expected and actual status are compared for all 20 cases. The report explicitly remains **not production-ready**.
